run.json records a successful pr-checks run on head 72393c3. The JUnit report shows 172 tests with 0 failures and 0 skips, including the LOG-1 and AUD-1 control tests (both sample-labelled). Two caveats: the report's timestamp (2026-10-23) and hostname (a developer laptop) don't match the run record (ci-runner-07, 2026-10-22), and I could not re-run the suite because pytest isn't installed.

The change relies on no exception. None of the register entries apply to payments.service or to LOG-1/AUD-1 for this component.
Ledger evidence covers payments.py, audit.py and routes.py. None of them changed, so no accepted evidence lapses.

summary: PR-1849 adds a single log line to LedgerService.amend_memo. The process records (ticket, independent approval on head, CI on head, no protected or security-sensitive paths) are in order. The new line is a log call site in LOG-1's domain, and LOG-1 requires exhaustive evidence. The only control test is a sample that doesn't exercise memo amendment, and the ledger has no LOG-1 evidence. The line looks benign on reading because it logs only a numeric payment id, but the required evidence isn't there, so the change is held rather than accepted.
